The speaker introduces Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), a framework that aims to improve the accuracy and timeliness of large language models (LLMs) by incorporating additional information from a retrieval mechanism. The example illustrates how RAG can help mitigate the limitations of LLMs, such as providing unverified or outdated answers, by grounding them in credible sources like NASA. By combining knowledge retrieval with generation capabilities, RAG enables more informed and reliable responses to user queries.
